session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Big Gap Down into Sell Climax, Rally Then Bear Channel Reversal' (ET+13 hrs, Nov 4/5, Nov 5 axis; inset Bear Breakout of Trading Range). Overnight sell climax with micro double bottom at 6797, rally through consecutive wedge tops to resistance at yesterday's low 6850 (00:35), low 2 sell setup and a bear channel decline to consecutive wedge bottoms (02:40 low 6797), a failed double-top major trend reversal rally 6816 (failed MTR), double top bull trap late (04:10) and double bottoms trading range into the 6803-6807 close.
